notes.body: Revierer: It wants me to resolve conflicts, but after I issue the recommended commands by hitting the "Resolve locally" button, there are no merge marks in dissect-smd.c.

commits_data.title: SMB: Add FID subtree to Create_AndX requests
commits_data.message:
SMB: Add FID subtree to Create_AndX requests

When there are multiple commands, only allow Create Andx, Create
File, and Delete to show filenames in COL_INFO. In all cases,
(multiples or not) display a maximum of 40 characters in
COL_INFO. If longer, display "Path: [See Packet Detail]".
